summary: LazyCodex (github.com/code-yeongyu/lazycodex) is a distribution wrapper for the OmO (oh-my-openagent) agent harness targeting the OpenAI Codex CLI. Its only CLI, bin/lazycodex-ai.js, expands `lazycodex-ai install …` to `npx --yes --package oh-my-openagent omo install --platform=codex …`, which installs the OmO Codex plugin (hooks, skills, agent roles, MCP servers, model catalog) into $CODEX_HOME/config.toml; the runtime that executes a task is `codex exec` (Codex CLI 0.156.1) with that plugin loaded. Codex talks to its configured `model_provider` over the OpenAI Responses API only (wire_api="chat" is rejected by this version), so the overlay adds a tiny zero-dependency Node sidecar on 127.0.0.1:4141 that serves /v1/responses and translates every call to $PROXY_URL/v1/chat/completions (streaming, function tools, Codex's code-mode custom `exec` tool and namespaced collaboration tools all verified). The run command starts the sidecar, pipes $TASK into `codex exec --json` in the task cwd with approvals/sandbox bypassed (the installer's --codex-autonomous defaults), and copies events, last message, session rollouts and logs to /out.
run_command: export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH; export CODEX_HOME=${CODEX_HOME:-/opt/harness/codex-home}; set -o pipefail; mkdir -p /out; export SHIM_LOG=/out/codex-responses-shim.log; codex-responses-shim & SHIM_PID=$!; for i in $(seq 1 100); do (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/4141) 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 0.1; done; printf '%s\n' "$TASK" | codex exec --skip-git-repo-check --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --color never --json -m "${LAZYCODEX_MODEL:-gpt-5.6-sol}" -o /out/last-message.md - | tee /out/codex-events.jsonl; RC=${PIPESTATUS[1]}; kill $SHIM_PID 2>/dev/null; cp -r "$CODEX_HOME/sessions" /out/codex-sessions 2>/dev/null; cp -r "$CODEX_HOME/plugins/data" /out/omo-plugin-data 2>/dev/null; exit $RC
check_command: export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH; export CODEX_HOME=${CODEX_HOME:-/opt/harness/codex-home}; codex --version && node /opt/harness/src/bin/lazycodex-ai.js --dry-run doctor && test -f "$CODEX_HOME/config.toml" && grep -q '^model_provider = "proxy"' "$CODEX_HOME/config.toml" && test -d "$CODEX_HOME"/plugins/cache/sisyphuslabs/omo && node --check /opt/harness/shim/codex-responses-shim.mjs && omo --help >/dev/null
notes:
VERIFIED: built and ran locally with Docker (arm64) on both debian:bookworm-slim and buildpack-deps:jammy with `--network none`, against a fake chat-completions backend inside the container: check_command passes; run_command runs Codex 0.156.1 + OmO plugin (SessionStart/PostToolUse hooks fired, project rules loaded), the model's tool call executed in the task cwd, exit 0, and /out received codex-events.jsonl, last-message.md, codex-sessions/ (rollouts), codex-responses-shim.log, omo-plugin-data/.

WHY A SIDECAR: Codex 0.156.1 aborts config load on `wire_api = "chat"` ("no longer supported", github.com/openai/codex/discussions/7782) and only speaks the Responses API; the proxy offers chat-completions + Anthropic messages. The embedded zero-dependency Node shim (/opt/harness/shim/codex-responses-shim.mjs, started by run_command on 127.0.0.1:4141) converts Responses<->Chat: instructions/developer->system, message items, function_call(_output)/custom_tool_call(_output)->tool_calls/tool messages, streaming SSE (response.created/output_text.delta/output_item.done/completed), usage, and non-2xx passthrough. Codex sends tools as an `additional_tools` input item containing `namespace` groups; the shim flattens them and re-emits calls with a `namespace` field, which is the only form Codex's router accepts for the `collaboration` (sub-agent) tools (bare/dotted names -> "unsupported call"; verified). Custom (grammar) tools such as code-mode `exec` become a function with a single `input` string and are mapped back to custom_tool_call (verified: Codex executed the nested exec_command). The model name is passed through unchanged; set SHIM_MODEL to override, SHIM_FORWARD_REASONING_EFFORT=1 to forward reasoning.effort, SHIM_DEBUG_DIR to dump raw request pairs.

TOOL SURFACE DEPENDS ON THE MODEL SLUG (Codex behavior, not the proxy's model): with the OmO-configured `gpt-5.6-sol` (LAZYCODEX_MODEL default, matches the installed catalog and agent-role TOMLs) Codex uses code mode: one custom `exec` JS tool wrapping nested tools (exec_command, apply_patch, MCP tools) plus wait/request_user_input and the collaboration namespace. An unknown slug (e.g. LAZYCODEX_MODEL=proxy-model) makes Codex fall back to classic flat function tools (exec_command, write_stdin, MCP tools) with a one-line "Model metadata not found" warning; both paths were verified through the shim. `--disable code_mode_host` does NOT give classic tools (fails closed).

INSTALL FIDELITY: the repo's only CLI (bin/lazycodex-ai.js) just runs `npx --yes --package oh-my-openagent omo install --platform=codex ...` (its --dry-run output is printed during the build and in check_command). The build installs that exact command from a pinned oh-my-openagent (npm `latest` = 4.19.4 at authoring; the repo's vendored plugins/omo is 5.0.0-beta.88 = npm tag `beta`; override with --build-arg OMO_VERSION=5.0.0-beta.88) and @openai/codex 0.156.1 into /opt/harness/node (self-contained Node 22 tarball; base image node/python untouched). `--codex-autonomous` writes approval_policy=never, sandbox_mode=danger-full-access, trusted hook hashes, features plugins/multi_agent/goals/unified_exec. The build then pre-runs OmO's bootstrap worker (otherwise the first SessionStart spawns it and it rewrites config.toml, re-enabling the context7 remote MCP), removes the unrecognized `network_access` key, adds model_provider=proxy + [model_providers.proxy] (base_url http://127.0.0.1:4141/v1, env_key OPENAI_API_KEY, wire_api responses), and disables the two remote MCP servers (context7, grep_app) that would need internet. No secrets baked; installer needs network only at build time (npm + ast-grep binary download). /etc/profile.d/lazycodex-harness.sh re-adds PATH because `bash -lc` sources /etc/profile which resets PATH on Debian/Ubuntu (this bit the first test); run/check also export PATH defensively.

RUNTIME BEHAVIOR TO KNOW: (1) OmO's CodeGraph SessionStart hook indexes the workspace in the background and writes a `.codegraph/` directory (sqlite db + its own .gitignore) into the task cwd; that is stock LazyCodex behavior. (2) OmO hooks write state under $CODEX_HOME/plugins/data and ~/.omo, ~/.local/share/lazycodex; CODEX_HOME is chmod a+rwX for non-root task users. (3) Auto-update and PostHog telemetry hooks are disabled via env; the SessionStart config migration is disabled so it cannot touch the provider block. (4) The prompt is fed via stdin (`-`) so any $TASK text is safe; --skip-git-repo-check allows non-git task dirs; the container is the sandbox (Codex's own sandbox is bypassed as the installer's autonomous mode intends). (5) request_max_retries/stream_max_retries=2 keep failures fast; SSE idle timeout is Codex's default. (6) COPY . includes the repo's .git (~96MB); harmless.
